company_news.headline: Cigna Healthcare Expands AI-Enabled Personalized Support to Help More Customers Access Care Earlier and Improve Affordability
company_news.summary: Cigna Healthcare®, the health benefits division of The Cigna Group (NYSE: CI), is significantly expanding its personalized care management programs through AI-enabled capabilities and predictive analytics that help identify customers who would benefit from earlier support and connect them with clinicians. company_news.headline: The Cigna Group Declares Quarterly Dividend
company_news.summary: The Board of Directors of The Cigna Group (NYSE: CI) today declared a cash dividend of $1.56 per share of its common stock, payable on September 23, 2026, to shareholders of record as of the close of business on September 8, 2026.
